preconditions.description: the current branch does not already track the new upstream branch.

preconditions.probe:
branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)
current=$(git for-each-ref --format='%(upstream:short)' "refs/heads/$branch")
test "$current" != "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}"

preconditions.description: there are no modified or staged tracked files.

preconditions.description: no untracked file would be overwritten by merging the new upstream branch.

preconditions.probe:
! comm -12 \
  <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} \
    | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .

preconditions.description: the local branch has commits not in the new upstream branch.

preconditions.description: the new upstream branch has commits not yet in HEAD.
